# Capstone Artifact Rules

- Keep each file focused on its stage deliverable only.
- Preserve the `## Approval` section.
- Record open questions instead of resolving them by assumption.
- Make outputs reviewable by a human without needing hidden context.
- Do not edit artifacts in another story folder unless the user explicitly switches stories.
